question: Do correlated current-season outputs (championship probability, playoff probability, expected wins and expected points) show enough independent decision leverage to justify immediate coefficient surgery?

retained_finalist_sensitivity.scope_limitation: Sensitivity was run on retained finalist alternatives, not the exhaustive candidate universe; it measures observed leverage, not correctness of the exchange rates.

closure.reason: The channels are statistically correlated, but the available ablations did not change the leading retained trade family. No historical or out-of-sample evidence identifies a better set of exchange rates, so replacing them now would substitute one unsupported coefficient set for another.
closure.future_recalibration_trigger: historical/out-of-sample evidence showing materially better decision prediction or ranking stability from a reduced/reweighted current-season objective
